messages:
liang: Quick flag — after int8 bring-up for astra-v2-lite I'm seeing a reproable merge of Kanji+ZWJ sequences. Small WMT-ish smoke shows BLEU drop ~2.8 for ja->en and weird token merges for zh->en. Anyone seen this pattern?

sophia: :eyes: can you paste a minimal repro and the eval command?

liang: repro below. ran on our redwood-evals subset (wmt-sample-2k). quant pipeline: `q8_dynamic` with kernel fallback, tokenizer is upstream spm model from model bundle.

liang: ```
# repro (condensed)
python eval_translate.py \\  --model-path /opt/models/astra-v2-lite/int8/ \\  --src-file samples/ja_small.src \\  --tgt-ref samples/ja_small.ref \\  --batch 8 \
```

liang: sample input: `今日は明日もよろしくお願いします` (ZWJ inserted between Kanji and punctuation for privacy redaction).

liang: baseline fp16 output: `Today. Please also take care of me tomorrow.`

liang: int8 output: `Today.Pleasealso tak ecare of me tomorrow.`  <-- tokens merged (no spaces) and a space injected in the middle of `take care`.

kim_ml: that looks like a tokenizer detok mismatch after quant kernel change. Could be whitespace/offset handling in the runtime KV chunking or batch-contiguous detokenization path. Did the quant build change the sentencepiece serialization?

liang: checked bundle: spm model identical sha256 to prod bundle. Kernel changes are only in the fused embedding + norm path.

ryan_infra: we landed a micro-optimization in the token-merge loop (PR #4829) that touches buffer write offsets when streaming tokens back to the detokenizer. Might be related.

liang: thanks — adding PR #4829 to bisect. Also ran token-id diffs for the sample: fp16 ids: [10,234,87,502,...] int8 ids: [10,234,872,502,...] -> see the 87 vs 872 (subtoken split/merge).

sophia: please run chrF and chrF++ too (BLEU sometimes hides small CJK detok errors). Also add a few manual examples with ZWJ/ZWSP/nbspace.

liang: did that: chrF -0.06, BLEU -2.8. BLEURT single-sample drops from 0.31 -> -0.12. Attached a short list of 6 failing examples in the eval run.

eval-bot: CI result for astra-v2-lite int8 bringup: smoke-evals failed (6/2000 regressions flagged), threshold exceeded. See https://ci.redwood/ast/4829

mike_prod: what is user impact? any hosted customers hit?

liang: so far only internal smoke set; no customer anomalies reported yet. But impact on translation quality for East-Asia locales could be noticeable for low-latency routes using int8.

kim_ml: short-term mitigation: revert the micro-opt in runtime or pin routing for ja/zh to fp16 until we triage. Also add a locale-specific smoke check for ZWJ/ZWSP combos in the preflight.

ryan_infra: will open an infra rollback ticket if we confirm PR #4829 is the cause. bisect in progress on my machine.

liang: putting a small checklist here: 1) bisect PR #4829 2) add 10 CJK ZWJ/ZWSP samples to smoke 3) run token-id map compare across batch sizes (1,8,32) 4) hold int8 rollouts for ja/zh routes.

sophia: thanks. If anyone wants to pair on the bisect ping me. I can help craft a minimal unit test that reproduces token id split/merge deterministically. :thumbsup:

liang: adding the failing example corpus to the eval issue: https://go/redwood/issue/ML-4521 — will update once bisect completes.
